subtasks: Keep both arms at their starting poses and observe the demonstration until the demonstrating arm has fully returned to its starting pose. Remember the object placement order.
Place the green wristwatch from the front-right of the table into the basket on the left, as the first object in the demonstrated order.
Place the black rectangular object from the center-right of the table into the basket on the left, as the second object in the demonstrated order.
Pick up the black rectangular object now lying on the table just to the right of the left basket, and place it inside that basket as the second object.
Place the blue mobile phone from the front-left of the table into the basket on the left, as the third object in the demonstrated order.
Place the black plush toy from the right side of the table into the basket on the left, as the fourth object in the demonstrated order.

Pick up the fallen black plush toy now beside the yellow truck near the center of the table, and place the plush into the basket on the left as the fourth object. The truck must wait until after the plush.
Place the yellow toy truck into the basket on the left as the fifth and final object in the demonstrated order.
Pick up the fallen yellow toy truck beside the right edge of the left basket and place it inside that basket as the fifth and final object.
Return both arms to their starting poses with grippers open. All five objects have been placed in the left basket.
